items.title: International Business Machines (IBM) Puts Quantum Encryption To Work On Heron R2
items.summary: International Business Machines (NYSE:IBM) supported Quantum X Labs in running an advanced quantum encryption trial on its Quantum Heron r2 processor. The Quantum X Labs experiment used IBM hardware to test an information theoretic security protocol for quantum secured communications in commercial settings. items.title: Ross Perot Left IBM in 1962 and Started a Company With $1,000. In 1984, General Motors Bought It for $2.5 Billion
items.summary: IBM capped his commissions, so Ross Perot quit with a borrowed $1,000 and a pitch his former employer had already rejected. What he built from that rejection forced one of America's largest corporations to come to him decades later.
